objective: Prepare a candidate entry for the sixth High-Lift Prediction Workshop test case 1 by running the published CRM-HLS blind case on the coarsest committee grid of 2.66 million cells across the six specified angles of attack, and assess whether the result is strong enough to be worth Katie approving an approach to the workshop organisers
rationale: This is the strongest externally verified credential currently open to this lab, and the scouting sweep of 2026-07-30 found it by looking. The workshop is underway as of January 2026 with the meeting expected June 2027, its submission repository is already public, and its participant list is full of companies including Boeing, Embraer, ONERA, DLR, JAXA and Bombardier, so a commercial entrant is normal rather than exceptional. Membership of the sponsoring society is not required. Decisively for us, the coarsest published grid is 2.66 million cells, which is under five times our largest ever converged primal, and the case is deliberately blind with no experimental data published, so there is nothing to tune toward and placing well cannot be an artifact of hindsight. A workshop entry that is externally rescored is worth more to this company than another internal case

cost_basis: MEASURED on 2026-08-01, superseding the earlier linear-in-cells estimate. The published grid was downloaded and imported and the real case was run on this box: 2,661,338 cells, 1,156,796 nodes, 1,883,036 prisms plus 341,341 pyramids plus 436,961 tetrahedra, 6,509,759 faces, every checkMesh topology test OK and every cell volume positive. RATE: 120 SIMPLE iterations of simpleFoam with kOmegaSST on 14 MPI ranks in 181.57 s of solver ExecutionTime, which is 1.513 s per iteration and 0.353 core-min per iteration. At the earlier basis's own assumption of 3,000 iterations per angle that is 1,059 core-min per angle and 6,354 core-min for the six specified angles, 1.77 times the previous 3,600. MEMORY IS NOT THE RISK AND THE EARLIER FLAG IS RETIRED: measured peak 4,420.6 MiB summed resident set across the 14 ranks, host MemAvailable never below 25,319 MiB of 30,102 MiB, so the box stayed above 84 percent free throughout. The measured primal law is 1.589 KiB per cell plus 842 MiB fixed at 14 ranks, fitted over a 7.96 times range of cell counts with a largest residual of 30 MiB, which puts this machine's primal ceiling near 20 million cells, between committee grid levels 3c and 3d rather than anywhere near the 2.66 million of level 3a. The adjoint memory envelope figures of 63,920 cells working and 99,840 failing were cited against this item and DO NOT APPLY to it: test case 1 is primal only, no derivative is requested, and that envelope is a property of the reverse-mode sweep in the optimisation framework. WHAT ACTUALLY BINDS, both newly established and neither previously on the record: first, this installation of OpenFOAM has no reader for the AFLR3 binary ugrid format or for CGNS, which are the only formats these committee grids are published in, so an importer had to be written and now sits in the repository scripts directory; second, the grid is built for node-centred codes and is hostile to a cell-centred solver, carrying 1,256,565 faces above 70 degrees non-orthogonality with a maximum of 89.98 degrees against rung A6's maximum of 70.4. Default numerics ran 14 clean iterations and then diverged, the pressure solve stalling at its 1000-iteration ceiling and a floating point exception following at iteration 16, with memory untouched at 4,790 MiB. A hardened configuration is stable across 120 iterations but needs first-order momentum convection and heavy relaxation, which is a deviation the specification would require be declared. REMAINING UNCERTAINTY, stated rather than buried: the 3,000-iteration assumption is not established and the evidence says it is low, since after 120 iterations the lift coefficient was still moving 2.5 percent every four iterations, and high-lift RANS at 25 to 35 degrees with separation behind slat brackets often never reaches a steady state at all. At 5,000 iterations per angle the six angles cost 10,590 core-min and at 10,000 they cost 21,180. Also unpriced: the required deliverables are eight mandatory views against a committee-supplied layout file, which is not in this number. DOLLARS: zero. The grid is an anonymous public download of 51,011,399 bytes fetched at 04:34:57 UTC on 2026-08-01, sha256 beginning 2fbce6ca. Nothing was sent, no account was created and no organiser was contacted. NOTE FOR PLANNING: submission is a pull request against the workshop's public code repository and needs a free account plus a workshop-assigned participant identifier, all of which this item's own ABSOLUTE list forbids. The entry can be prepared but cannot be sent without Katie's decision. That, not compute, is now the gate.
expected_knowledge_gain: The first externally rescored aerodynamic result this lab would ever hold, on a blind case, judged beside national laboratories and airframers. Even a mediocre placement establishes that our pipeline runs a modern high lift configuration end to end at several million cells, which no current record demonstrates. A failure is nearly as informative, since it would locate our ceiling against a published grid rather than against our own guess
launch_prompt: Prepare, do not send. Download the sixth High-Lift Prediction Workshop test case 1 specification and the coarsest published grid of the HeldenMesh family, 2661338 cells, from the public grid store. FIRST run a memory probe at a single angle of attack and report peak resident set size before queueing anything else; this grid is 4.6 times our largest ever converged primal and the memory envelope at that size is not established. If the probe fits, run the six specified angles of attack from 10 to 35 degrees at the published conditions of Mach 0.20 and chord Reynolds number 3.55 million, free air with no tunnel or support hardware. Produce the required outputs, which are surface streamlines, skin friction magnitude contours (magnitude, not the x component), and pressure and skin friction along the defined rows. Report every deviation from the specification plainly. ABSOLUTE: do not contact the workshop organisers, do not join a technology focus group distribution list, do not request a participant identifier, do not open a merge request against the submission repository, and do not create any account. Katie decides whether this lab approaches this workshop at all, and she proofreads anything that would be sent. The deliverable here is a result plus an honest assessment of whether it is worth her approving that approach.
cost_basis_previous: Measured on this machine on 2026-08-01, replacing the earlier estimate. The coarsest committee grid was downloaded, imported, decomposed and solved here. It parses to exactly 2661338 cells, 1156796 nodes and 6509759 faces, all prisms, pyramids and tetrahedra, which confirms the cited cell count against the grid file itself. Peak memory across every stage was 4548 MiB against 31380 MiB of host memory, a headroom factor of 6.7, so the memory question the earlier basis left open is answered and memory was never the risk. The per cell figure comes from a measured slope over a four rung ladder at 334647, 673920, 1320300 and 2664180 cells rather than from one point, and it over predicts the real grid by 11 percent because a structured mesh carries more faces per cell, so it is a bound in the safe direction. Throughput measured at 120 iterations in 182.63 seconds on 14 ranks, which is 0.355 core minutes per iteration, 2.02 times the rate the earlier basis assumed. The cause is rank count and grid type, not cell count: rung A6 ran 4 ranks on a structured extruded mesh and parallel efficiency here is about 45 percent, so 14 ranks buys 6.3 times the wall speed for 2.23 times the core minutes. Carrying the earlier assumption of 3000 iterations across the six angles gives 6390 core minutes at 14 ranks, or 4014 serial over 67 hours of wall time. Two things remain unpriced and are stated rather than hidden. The iteration count is still an assumption, which is the same defect that overran the flat plate finest rung, and at the upper angles steady RANS often refuses to settle. And the configuration measured as stable uses first order convection, which is not a defensible submission; a second order entry is dearer and less robust. What actually blocks this item is not memory but numerics on a grid built for node centred codes, with 1256565 severely non orthogonal faces, plus the fact that no reader for the published grid format existed here until one was written.
repriced_note: Repriced 2026-08-01 from a direct measurement on the real committee grid rather than an estimate. The feasibility question is answered: it runs on this machine, in 4.4 GiB of 30. See the probe record under the agenda's hlpw6_probe directory.
